description: This file is a Java Spring controller class named SecurityController, responsible for handling security-related admin web requests such as displaying user permissions and group information in a web application.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Controller class for managing security-related admin web pages, including user permissions and group management.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display permissions page; sets the menu and returns the view name for permissions.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display groups; retrieves list of groups of type ADMIN and adds to the model for the view.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set up menu attributes in the model based on request attributes.
